name: Student Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires acceptance into a full-time academic programme at a designated learning institution in Trinidad and Tobago.
Passport must be valid for at least 12 months.

evidence_required.document: Acceptance letter from a designated learning institution
Fee: TTD 100 (CARICOM nationals) or TTD 200 (non-CARICOM nationals), non-refundable

outcome.duration_length: tied to the academic programme, renewable annually via assessment form

sources.title: ttconnect, Government of Trinidad and Tobago -- Visa & Student Permit: student permit eligibility, CARICOM/non-CARICOM fee differential, renewal assessment form, 5-step online process

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Trinidad and Tobago's initial build. Notable CARICOM-preferential fee structure (TTD 100 vs. TTD 200) consistent with Trinidad and Tobago's role as a CARICOM Single Market and Economy (CSME) member state -- see tt_csme_skills_certificate.json for the broader CARICOM free-movement mechanism. No work rights confirmed, including for internships -- modelled conservatively as none absent evidence otherwise.
